verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a document-processing platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server applies here. First-party docs describe a hosted platform MCP endpoint (https://mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp) that exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split and Index as tools any MCP client can call. There is also a separate docs MCP server (search_docs, grep_docs, read_doc) with a ready `claude mcp add` command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the platform MCP server, documented setup and authentication steps for connecting an agent to the platform endpoint (the one-line install shown is for the docs server only).
